question: What cosmic sound-consciousness and universal adornment characterize this deity?
premises: The deity is the foremost consciousness-maker of the great sound.
The deity wears the universe as an offering-girdle.
inference: This deity is linked to primordial sound-consciousness and encompasses the universe as adornment.
plain_english: He is the foremost maker of consciousness from the great sound and wears the universe as his offering-girdle.
